name: sop
description: Execute a Standard Operating Procedure end-to-end. Can run in yolo mode (auto-confirm all gates) or interactive mode.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: Workflow definition ID (e.g., 'code_optimization') or path to SOP file

parameters.name: --model
parameters.description: Override the LLM model for all phase inferencers

parameters.name: --params
parameters.description: JSON key-value parameters for the SOP (e.g., '{"target_path": "src/foo"}')
